reasoning_content: Good — the frontend pnpm resolves to the pinned 10.30.2 via corepack. Next, let's check process-compose's API. 8080 is returning "404 page not found" — hmm, but the summary says "Process Compose API: http://localhost:8080". Wait, docker ps didn't show a process-compose container… process-compose is running on the host via `uv run poe process-compose`. Port 8080 on the host is… wait, keycloak's container port is 8080/tcp but it's not exposed to the host. Let's check what's listening on 8080 and what the process-compose API endpoint is. The process-compose API's default is /api/processes… but that returned 404. Maybe it's a different path. Let's check.

action.command: ss -tlnp | grep -E ':(3000|3002|8080|8081)\b' ; echo "---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/; curl -s http://localhost:8080/ | head -c 300; echo; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'api/v1: %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/api/v1/processes

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "ss -tlnp | grep -E ':(3000|3002|8080|8081)\\b' ; echo \"---\"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\\n' http://localhost:8080/; curl -s http://localhost:8080/ | head -c 300; echo; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'api/v1: %{http_code}\\n' http://localhost:8080/api/v1/processes", "summary": "Find process-compose API on port 8080", "security_risk": "LOW"}
